skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and identify various types of contracts in investment projects, their conditions, advantages, and limitations. Apply knowledge to draft contracts according to legal regulations.
Understand the process and content of contract management, from drafting to signing and execution.
Understand and apply negotiation skills in contract management.
Understand and manage relationships and prevent disputes and claims that may arise during contract execution.
Understand and apply methods and criteria to evaluate contract performance and manage contract risks.
Understand and apply legal compliance in contract management.
Demonstrate the ability to work independently, in groups, and with a sense of responsibility and professional ethics.
Apply critical thinking to evaluate contract performance and management.
Communicate effectively in contract management scenarios.
Solve problems related to contract management and execution.
